caseName: National Labor Relations Board v. Local 742, United Brotherhood of Carpenters & Joiners
caseNameFull: National Labor Relations Board v. Local 742, United Brotherhood of Carpenters & Joiners of America and J. L. Simmons Co., Inc. v. Local 742, United Brotherhood of Carpenters & Joiners of America

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and cases remanded for further consideration in light of NLRB v. Pipefitters, 429 U. S. 507 (1977). Reported below: 174 U. S. App. D. C. 456, 533 F. 2d 683.
